description: UK company insolvency notices (administrations, liquidations, winding-up petitions) from The Gazette, via our nightly cache of the last 8 days. Filter by company name or number, postcode prefix, notice type and date. Returns company, number, notice type, date, nature of business, postcode and notice link, with the cache timestamp and any missing days; up to 10 rows can add Companies House status, SIC codes and address. Price: $0.003 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

postcode.description: Postcode prefix, e.g. SW1 or M1 1AE

q.description: Company name text or company number

since.description: YYYY-MM-DD, default 7 days ago, clipped to the cache window

type.description: administration, liquidation, winding-up, petition, creditors, or a notice name or 4-digit code

name: uk_insolvency
title: Uk Insolvency
